decisions.statement: A title the page did not give falls back to the title the contents listed.
A chapter whose title leaves no slug behind is slugged `untitled`.
The day a chapter was published is read off the chapter's URL.
The links to the chapters either side are no part of a chapter's prose.
A chapter behind patron early access is known by the chapter's title.

definition: the conventions a Wandering Inn chapter is named and read by
